items.title: NVIDIA Elastic Latent Recurrence: one looped checkpoint that matches a standard model at one loop and gains up to 7.25 points at four
items.summary: NVIDIA paper (Ladhak, Ginsburg and others) on training looped language models without the usual one-loop accuracy penalty, using a gated state update with a learned step size, mixed loop counts in each optimizer step, and loop-index conditioning. On 4B dense and 30B-A3B MoE hybrids, one loop lands 0.52 points below and 1.04 above matched baselines on a ten-task average, and four loops add 7.25 and 4.75 points. Keeping only the last loop's KV cache holds attention memory at one-loop size. The post-trained Koi-4B checkpoint is estimated at 18 on the Artificial Analysis index at one loop and 29 at four.

items.title: Rapid-MLX 1.0.1 adds five local speech models on Mac, including Granite Speech 5.0 at about 640x real time
items.summary: Rapid-MLX 1.0.1 (released 2026-11-02 03:25Z) adds five on-device speech models for Apple Silicon: Granite Speech 5.0 (30 s of audio transcribed in 0.05 s per the team), Nemotron 3.5 ASR across 40 locales, FireRedASR2 for Mandarin, and VoxCPM2 plus MOSS-TTS-Nano for text to speech. The release also moves to Python 3.12+, refuses catalog models that will not fit in memory before downloading, and lets Community Benchmark use the same speed settings as serve.

doubt.note: Speed figures are the team's own; no independent benchmark yet.

security_forwarded.note: Update to CVE-2026-98432 (forwarded 2026-10-30 as medium). Ubuntu's tracker now rates it High priority, CVSS 9.8 critical: a use-after-free in IPv4 TCP SYN/SYNACK handling of IP options (inet_opt/ireq_opt freed without an RCU grace period), so disabling MPTCP alone does not cover it. Verified on the Ubuntu tracker (last updated 2026-10-30): linux-nvidia-6.17 on 24.04 noble is 'Ignored, end of life', so the DGX Spark's 6.17 nvidia kernel will not get a fix; linux-nvidia-7.0 and generic noble linux are still 'Vulnerable' (generic noble work in progress in 6.8.0-149). Upstream fixed in 5.10.272, 5.15.223, 6.1.190, 6.6.159, 6.12.113, 6.18.56, 7.2.10 and 7.3 per the post. Interim mitigation in the post: an nftables prerouting rule at priority -300 dropping IPv4 TCP packets that carry IP options (ip hdrlength gt 5), skipped on CIPSO networks. Box kernel is 6.12.94+ (below the 6.12.113 fix, MPTCP enabled) but it is a managed sandbox. Not messaged by me: urgent finding filed to Mini Master inbox for routing to Bouncer.
